confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated or crowdsourced Bangkok price sources of mixed and partly undated vintage, so treat them as ballparks. Cocktail rests on only a few sources. Wine by the glass is weakly supported: it is estimated from restaurant and retail bottle prices and the local beer relationship, not from direct glass-price evidence. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no accommodation search or live listing check. THB figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 33 THB per USD, which was not searched and should be checked. FX: the only RBA observation I could confirm is 0.7088 for 2026-03-20, which is not the latest available on 2026-11-19. A later third-party figure (0.7021 for 2026-10-27) could not be verified on rba.gov.au and was not used. Replace the fx block with the latest RBA F11.1 observation before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Bangkok-specific, drawn from searched price sources. Accommodation tiers are a holistic model estimate of typical Bangkok hostel and hotel pricing for July 2026.
